agents.name: Atlas
agents.mission: Writes the plan and the idea bank, assigns the waves, merges every branch, verifies every piece live in the Simulator with real taps, and ships (commit + push).

agents.name: Nocturne
agents.mission: Makes night the app's best hour: the Night Desk, Put the day down, a room that dims by the hour, stars, a night owl's later night, Sunday night.

agents.name: Lumen
agents.mission: Makes every page agree: empty states with Ember art, one card and spacing scale, numbers that line up, Settings that reads like a story, What's New, jump chips, the new dot.

agents.name: Spark
agents.mission: Builds the things that make it feel like nothing else: the candle shelf of weeks, Ember remembering firsts, the streak of light, sealed notes, the tiny wins radar, a study buddy.

agents.name: Glide
agents.mission: Makes everything glide: numbers that move when they change, rows that travel between groups, a liquid tab pill, springy chips, lazy long lists, haptic ticks, one queue for toasts, hold-the-flame calm.

agents.name: Guide
agents.mission: Makes the app show well: a guided tour in show mode, the wake screen, a welcome that ends with This-or-that, a screenshot script, and a one-page story of the app.

agents.name: Sentinel
agents.mission: Sweeps the whole codebase for crash risks, unstable selectors, missing labels, Reduce Motion gaps, and house-rule breaks; fixes the safe ones in files nobody else owns and files the rest as ideas.
owns: any file not owned by another agent this wave

agents.name: Scout
agents.mission: Reads every screen and the stores behind them, and adds grounded ideas to the bank: each one names the page, what's missing, and why it would help a high schooler.

agents.name: Scribe
agents.mission: Writes the words around the work: What's New entries, docs/about-the-app.md, the session log draft, and idea-bank housekeeping, from facts Atlas hands it.

rules: Build with Screen and the kit in components/ui; every tap goes through Pressy.
Candlelight only: night palette, gold is the one action color, Fraunces for voice, Figtree for the rest.
No uppercase eyebrows, no middle-dot joins, sentence case, calm words, counts through plural().
goBack() not router.back(); haptics through core/haptics; selectors return stable references.
Reanimated: worklets on the UI thread, no dependency arrays, every motion has a Reduce Motion path.
Stores: only add optional fields; never save before loaded; nothing saves while showing Riley.
Privacy: nothing new goes to the AI unless opted in, with a line saying what is sent; crisis words always show help lines.
AI proposes, the student taps, and it can be undone. Every delete has Undo.
No native rebuilds and no new packages in a wave; note them as ideas instead.
Every decision gets its reason written down. Never claim something was checked live unless it was.

policy.concurrency: At most 2 agents at a time, so streams never stall and usage stays smooth

models.job: Orchestrate, design each task packet, merge, verify live, ship
Mechanical sweeps: labels, plurals, small fixes, tests

rules: Atlas does the design thinking once and hands a short packet; agents don't explore.
Agents read tools/hub/CONTEXT.md (90 lines) instead of CLAUDE.md and the plan docs (900 lines).
Big files are read by grep and line ranges, never whole, never twice.
Hub events only at claim, milestone, done; reports stay under 30 lines.
Atlas checks usage before each launch and stops at 90% of the 5-hour or 95% of the weekly limit.
